title: RNA Extraction Protocol for Snake Genomes Using TRIzol Reagent
author: Boyang Liu
materials: RNA is purified with an RNA extraction kit (Thermo Scientific, USA), and RNA was eluted with DEPC.

steps.title: Prepare Laboratory and Equipment
steps.instruction: Sterilize the laboratory and test bench and prepare all necessary equipment to prevent RNase contamination.

substeps.instruction: Sterilize the laboratory and test bench using alcohol and ultraviolet light for 30 minutes.
Sterilize equipment (e.g., mortar and pestle) at high temperature one day before the experiment and dry in an oven.
Wear masks and gloves throughout the RNA extraction process.

steps.title: Homogenize Sample and Lyse Tissue
steps.instruction: Grind the tissue sample and mix with TRIzol reagent.

substeps.instruction: Place 50 mg of scented glands into a pre-cooled mortar.
Quickly grind the sample into powder using liquid nitrogen.
Add 1 ml TRIZOL and mix with the tissue powder.
Transfer the mixture into a centrifuge tube and let it stand at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the RNA from proteins and lipids using chloroform and centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 ml of chloroform to the centrifuge tube.
Shake the tube for 15 s to mix chloroform and TRIZOL well.
Let the mixture stand at room temperature for 10 min.
Centrifuge at 12,000 r/min (rpm) for 15 min at 4°C.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Recover the aqueous phase and precipitate the RNA with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Collect the upper aqueous phase and transfer it into a new centrifuge tube.
Add ethanol at three times the volume of the aqueous phase and mix.
Let the solution stand at room temperature for 10 min.

steps.title: RNA Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA using a purification column and remove residual ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add the mixed solution to the purification column.
Centrifuge at 12,000 r/min (rpm) at 4°C for 2 min.
Repeat the centrifugation step three times to ensure ethanol removal.

steps.title: Stabilization and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Stabilize the extracted RNA and verify its quality.

substeps.instruction: Add RNase inhibitors to prevent RNA degradation.
Mark the outside of the centrifuge tube.
Check RNA purity and concentration.
Confirm RNA integrity using electrophoresis.
